developments.titleZh: Oracle 公布 2026 財年第四季及全年業績
developments.summary: Oracle reported cloud infrastructure growth alongside capital investment and negative fiscal-year free cash flow.

developments.title: Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend
developments.titleZh: Broadcom 公布 2026 財年第三季業績及季度股息
developments.summary: Broadcom reported AI semiconductor demand and results within its broader semiconductor and infrastructure software businesses.
developments.summaryZh: Broadcom 公布 AI 半導體需求與業績，其業務同時涵蓋其他半導體及基礎設施軟體。

developments.title: Applied Digital Signs 210 MW Lease at Delta Forge 2, Expanding Its AI Factory Franchise Model to a Fifth Campus
developments.titleZh: Applied Digital · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Applied Digital announced a 210 MW critical IT lease at Delta Forge 2 with an investment-grade U.S. hyperscaler. The 15-year base term represents approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue.
developments.summaryZh: Applied Digital 宣布 Delta Forge 2 與美國投資等級大型雲端業者簽訂 210 MW 關鍵 IT 負載租約，15 年基本租期約有 52 億美元合約收入。

developments.title: Core Scientific Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: Core Scientific · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Core Scientific reported approximately 1.1 GW of leased customer power and 437 MW billing by mid-July. Its AMD partnership includes 15-year agreements for approximately 530 MW across five sites.
developments.summaryZh: Core Scientific 公布約 1.1 GW 已租客戶電力容量，7 月中旬已有 437 MW 開始計費；AMD 合作包含五個場址約 530 MW 的 15 年協議。

developments.title: GDS Holdings Limited Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: GDS Holdings · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: GDS reported Q2 revenue of RMB3.088 billion and 79.2% utilization. It raised 2026 revenue guidance to RMB12.7–13.0 billion and capex guidance to approximately RMB10 billion as data-center development increases.
developments.summaryZh: GDS 公布第二季收入人民幣 30.88 億元、使用率 79.2%，並將 2026 收入指引提高至人民幣 127 至 130 億元，資本支出約 100 億元，以擴大資料中心建設。

developments.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook
developments.titleZh: Equinix · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Equinix reported 11% monthly recurring revenue growth and 9,700 net interconnection additions in Q2. Capacity expansion included 52 projects in 33 markets, while 2026 capital expenditure guidance reached $5–6 billion.
developments.summaryZh: Equinix 公布第二季月經常性收入成長 11%、淨增加 9,700 個互連連線；33 個市場共有 52 個擴建專案，2026 資本支出指引達 50 至 60 億美元。

developments.title: Arista Introduces Next-Generation 1.6Terabit Portfolio for AI Fabrics
developments.titleZh: Arista Networks · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Arista introduced 7060XE7 networking for rack-scale AI fabrics, with air-cooled 1.6T availability planned for Q4 2026 and other models for Q1 2027.
developments.summaryZh: Arista 推出用於機架級 AI 網路的 7060XE7 系列；氣冷 1.6T 型號預計 2026 年第四季供貨，其他型號預計 2027 年第一季。

developments.title: QUANTA SERVICES REPORTS SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
developments.titleZh: Quanta Services · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Quanta reported acquisitions of Phalcon and Enerfab that expand electrical, fabrication and mechanical capabilities serving data-center and other infrastructure customers.
developments.summaryZh: Quanta 公布收購 Phalcon 與 Enerfab，擴充服務資料中心及其他基礎設施客戶的電氣、製造與機械工程能力。

developments.title: GE Vernova expands Pennsylvania manufacturing facility to strengthen U.S. grid supply chain
developments.titleZh: GE Vernova · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: GE Vernova expanded its Charleroi factory as part of a $138 million investment to improve production of high-voltage breakers, switchgear and instrument transformers.
developments.summaryZh: GE Vernova 以 1.38 億美元投資計畫擴充 Charleroi 工廠，提高高壓斷路器、開關設備與儀用變壓器的生產能力。

developments.title: Constellation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: Constellation Energy · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Constellation reported FERC approval for capacity interconnection rights transfer and NRC fuel-license approval at Crane, advancing an expected 2027 restart.
developments.summaryZh: Constellation 公布 Crane 容量互連權利移轉獲 FERC 核准、燃料執照獲 NRC 核准，推進預期 2027 年重啟。

developments.title: Bloom Energy and Oracle Expand Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 2.8 GW to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Build-Out
developments.titleZh: Bloom Energy · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Bloom announced an Oracle master agreement for up to 2.8 GW of fuel cells, with 1.2 GW contracted and deployment continuing into 2027.
developments.summaryZh: Bloom 公布 Oracle 燃料電池主協議，最高容量 2.8 GW，其中 1.2 GW 已簽約，部署持續至 2027 年。

developments.title: Oracle Announces Record Q4 and FY 2026 Results Driven by Cloud Infrastructure & Cloud Applications
developments.titleZh: Oracle 公布 2026 財年第四季及全年業績
developments.summary: Oracle reported cloud infrastructure growth alongside capital investment and negative fiscal-year free cash flow.
developments.summaryZh: Oracle 公布雲端基礎設施成長，同時說明資本投入及全年負自由現金流。

developments.title: Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend
developments.titleZh: Broadcom 公布 2026 財年第三季業績及季度股息
developments.summary: Broadcom reported AI semiconductor demand and results within its broader semiconductor and infrastructure software businesses.
developments.summaryZh: Broadcom 公布 AI 半導體需求與業績，其業務同時涵蓋其他半導體及基礎設施軟體。

developments.title: Applied Digital Signs 210 MW Lease at Delta Forge 2, Expanding Its AI Factory Franchise Model to a Fifth Campus
developments.titleZh: Applied Digital · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Applied Digital announced a 210 MW critical IT lease at Delta Forge 2 with an investment-grade U.S. hyperscaler. The 15-year base term represents approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue.
developments.summaryZh: Applied Digital 宣布 Delta Forge 2 與美國投資等級大型雲端業者簽訂 210 MW 關鍵 IT 負載租約，15 年基本租期約有 52 億美元合約收入。

developments.title: Core Scientific Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: Core Scientific · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Core Scientific reported approximately 1.1 GW of leased customer power and 437 MW billing by mid-July. Its AMD partnership includes 15-year agreements for approximately 530 MW across five sites.
developments.summaryZh: Core Scientific 公布約 1.1 GW 已租客戶電力容量，7 月中旬已有 437 MW 開始計費；AMD 合作包含五個場址約 530 MW 的 15 年協議。

developments.title: GDS Holdings Limited Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: GDS Holdings · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: GDS reported Q2 revenue of RMB3.088 billion and 79.2% utilization. It raised 2026 revenue guidance to RMB12.7–13.0 billion and capex guidance to approximately RMB10 billion as data-center development increases.
developments.summaryZh: GDS 公布第二季收入人民幣 30.88 億元、使用率 79.2%，並將 2026 收入指引提高至人民幣 127 至 130 億元，資本支出約 100 億元，以擴大資料中心建設。

developments.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook
developments.titleZh: Equinix · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Equinix reported 11% monthly recurring revenue growth and 9,700 net interconnection additions in Q2. Capacity expansion included 52 projects in 33 markets, while 2026 capital expenditure guidance reached $5–6 billion.
developments.summaryZh: Equinix 公布第二季月經常性收入成長 11%、淨增加 9,700 個互連連線；33 個市場共有 52 個擴建專案，2026 資本支出指引達 50 至 60 億美元。

developments.title: Arista Introduces Next-Generation 1.6Terabit Portfolio for AI Fabrics
developments.titleZh: Arista Networks · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Arista introduced 7060XE7 networking for rack-scale AI fabrics, with air-cooled 1.6T availability planned for Q4 2026 and other models for Q1 2027.
developments.summaryZh: Arista 推出用於機架級 AI 網路的 7060XE7 系列；氣冷 1.6T 型號預計 2026 年第四季供貨，其他型號預計 2027 年第一季。

developments.title: QUANTA SERVICES REPORTS SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
developments.titleZh: Quanta Services · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Quanta reported acquisitions of Phalcon and Enerfab that expand electrical, fabrication and mechanical capabilities serving data-center and other infrastructure customers.
developments.summaryZh: Quanta 公布收購 Phalcon 與 Enerfab，擴充服務資料中心及其他基礎設施客戶的電氣、製造與機械工程能力。

developments.title: GE Vernova expands Pennsylvania manufacturing facility to strengthen U.S. grid supply chain
developments.titleZh: GE Vernova · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: GE Vernova expanded its Charleroi factory as part of a $138 million investment to improve production of high-voltage breakers, switchgear and instrument transformers.
developments.summaryZh: GE Vernova 以 1.38 億美元投資計畫擴充 Charleroi 工廠，提高高壓斷路器、開關設備與儀用變壓器的生產能力。

developments.title: Constellation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
developments.titleZh: Constellation Energy · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Constellation reported FERC approval for capacity interconnection rights transfer and NRC fuel-license approval at Crane, advancing an expected 2027 restart.
developments.summaryZh: Constellation 公布 Crane 容量互連權利移轉獲 FERC 核准、燃料執照獲 NRC 核准，推進預期 2027 年重啟。

developments.title: Bloom Energy and Oracle Expand Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 2.8 GW to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Build-Out
developments.titleZh: Bloom Energy · 官方業務進展
developments.summary: Bloom announced an Oracle master agreement for up to 2.8 GW of fuel cells, with 1.2 GW contracted and deployment continuing into 2027.
developments.summaryZh: Bloom 公布 Oracle 燃料電池主協議，最高容量 2.8 GW，其中 1.2 GW 已簽約，部署持續至 2027 年。
